dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast structures are present across the mid-dorsal surface. The perimeters exhibit sharp pixel-intensity gradients from dark centers to bright exterior edges with non-uniform, jagged boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Dense clusters of asymmetrical, low-intensity dark pixels are localized between the ring structures. These blobs maintain high internal value uniformity and are primarily concentrated on the anterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper-central dorsal plane form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship. A secondary group of four high-intensity blobs on the lower lateral flank forms a trapezoidal polygon.
